register_ytvis_2019_datasets: register all YTVIS 2019 dataset splits (train, val, test) with Detectron2 using a root directory path
register_ytvis_2021_datasets: register all YTVIS 2021 dataset splits (train, val, test) with Detectron2 using a root directory path
review_predefined_splits_ytvis_2019: review the predefined YTVIS 2019 dataset split paths for train, validation, and test sets
review_predefined_splits_ytvis_2021: review the predefined YTVIS 2021 dataset split paths for train, validation, and test sets
run_builtin_dataset_registration: run the builtin module to register all YTVIS 2019 and 2021 datasets using the DETECTRON2_DATASETS environment variable
